author: Sam Illingworth and named parent contributors, especially Joel Salinas
reported_outcomes: Salinas describes encyclopedia-first inquiry. Ouyang describes adult-supplied image guidance and math questions followed by child drawing and paper work. Accounts differ in age and rules.
proposed_outcomes: Support family inquiry and real-world activity with adult judgment.
limits: Parent anecdotes are not developmental comparisons.
Sweeping research and screen-time claims in the introduction are not adopted.
Supervision and an achieved artifact do not by themselves demonstrate retained skill.
review_note: Merge the encyclopedia variant into inquiry-first. Keep Ouyang’s child-does-the-work example in the source distillation as an adjacent example, without endorsing her agent setup.
coverage: Close-read all 241 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
